requested_primary_changes.reason: Private task/retrieval query text and untrusted free-form MCP error text can be persisted in logs and progress events.
Stage 06 uses legacy progress events with no forecast/run/version identity or latency, and has no measured semantic lifecycle matrix beyond successful MCP round-trip latency.

A failure raised by session.call_tool crosses the decorated child span before the outer handler replaces it with a stable code, so the raw exception may be recorded by LangSmith and failure latency is lost.
FinBERT records the mutable branch main and VADER records no lexicon content identity, so the required exact model/lexicon provenance cannot be reconstructed from emitted metadata.

privacy_checks.check: All reachable Stage 06 LangSmith decorators define explicit input/output processors.
privacy_checks.evidence: Five traceable call sites were found in agents/sentiment_agent.py: MCP dispatch, brain plan, brain analyze, executor and whole run. Each supplies process_inputs and process_outputs, and normal outputs are reduced to allowlisted identity/count/flag fields.

privacy_checks.check: MCP failure spans cannot capture raw provider exceptions.
privacy_checks.evidence: _sentiment_call_tool awaits session.call_tool inside the decorated boundary without an inner failure sanitizer. The outer _call catches only after the child span has observed the original exception. OBS-06-003 is blocking.

privacy_checks.check: Logs, progress and Sentry contain no raw evidence, private query text, credentials or free-form provider errors.
privacy_checks.evidence: Sentry server and agent paths use stable synthetic RuntimeError messages and do not capture raw evidence. However task_query is logged at agents/sentiment_agent.py:785-788; retrieval_query is logged/published at 265-270 and logged again at 481-482; free-form MCP payload error text is logged/published at 434-443. OBS-06-001 is blocking.

privacy_checks.check: SharedManagerState persistence excludes brain_reasoning, raw chunks, duplicate source metadata and complete attempts.
privacy_checks.evidence: The agent keeps working evidence only in private graph state, then commits compact_sentiment_summary plus MonthlySentimentFeatures.to_state_slot at lines 1014-1019. The allowlist omits brain_reasoning, attempts, retrieved_chunks and sources_metadata; the offline suite includes assertions for these exclusions.

privacy_checks.check: Persisted feature evidence is reference-only and includes missing/degraded flags.
privacy_checks.evidence: MonthlySentimentFeatures.to_state_slot stores aggregates, bounded counts, availability, compact evidence IDs, version fields, missing/degraded booleans and flags. No article text or full metadata is included.

privacy_checks.check: Exact immutable sentiment model provenance is available for traces and reconstruction.
privacy_checks.evidence: FinBERT's model_version is ProsusAI/finbert@main plus transformers version; main is mutable. VADER records the NLTK version and vader_lexicon identifier but no resource content/version identity. OBS-06-004 is blocking.

privacy_checks.check: No external provider, external trace service, database, migration, seed, deploy, commit or push was contacted or executed by Observability.

tests_run.command: python -m pytest <all locked Stage06 sentiment unit and offline integration files> -q -m not-live/not-slow/not-db
SHA-256 verification of all 16 draft-recorded source/test paths and the Stage05 dependency handoff
independent static audit of Stage06 trace, progress, log, Sentry, Shared State, latency and version provenance surfaces

blocking_issues: OBS-06-001: private query/free-form error text can be persisted in logs and progress.
OBS-06-002: required versioned progress and measured Stage 06 lifecycle latency/count/degraded matrix is absent.
OBS-06-003: original MCP/provider exception can cross the decorated child span before sanitization.
OBS-06-004: FinBERT and VADER provenance is not an immutable exact local artifact identity.
limitations: The audit was static and offline; no live sentiment provider, external trace service or database was contacted.
Passing functional tests do not clear the blockers because the locked Stage 06 suite has no payload-leak, failure-span, forecast-progress or lifecycle-latency sentinel.
Observability changed no source, test, control-state, migration or shared instrumentation file.
Stage 07 remains PENDING/NOT_STARTED and was not modified.
